newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel soars on futures, market choked.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel soars on futures, market choked.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was pulled higher on Monday as benchmark IPE futures soared on the U.N. decision to freeze the Iraqi oil-for-food deal, but traders said the hike in prices had choked the market.

On the barges, premiums were put at Sept IPE +$22/+$23 a tonne but traders said it was very quiet. "A lot of players are waiting to see what New York does with Iraqi news. Unless they're desperate they're staying out," one trader said.
Cargoes were offered at fob premiums of Sept +$25/+$26. Traders said four or five players were looking for material but not at the current high levels. +44 171 542 7714.
